picks.excerpt: Luminate announced an AI music framework that will attach 'AI Generated' labels to songs and artist profiles later this year, using its own identification tech plus data from streaming services and AI music companies. The data layer the whole industry charts from is about to start declaring what's machine-made.
picks.rationale: The industry's core data provider will start flagging AI tracks — provenance metadata becomes something every release has to plan for, not just streaming platforms.

picks.excerpt: Sound On Sound reviews SpectraLayers Pro 13, Steinberg's spectral editor whose AI unmixing and separation engines keep getting better at pulling clean layers out of finished mixes. It's the least hyped but most practical face of AI audio: repair, restoration and remix surgery.
picks.rationale: A hands-on verdict on a named release — the unmix/repair workflow producers can actually run on a session tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: Researchers trained AI models that can identify iconic jazz pianists from their recordings alone, and in doing so exposed the measurable 'musical fingerprints' — timing, voicing, touch — that make a player recognisable. It hints at analysis tools that could describe personal style as a set of editable parameters.
picks.rationale: Turns 'personal style' into measurable parameters — the research groundwork for tools that can analyse, teach, or reproduce a player's feel.

picks.excerpt: Chartmetric launched Flow, an AI layer over its music-analytics platform that it insists is 'not just another AI chatbot' but an agent that runs multi-step research across artist data. A look at how AI is being wired into the tools artist teams actually plan campaigns with.
picks.rationale: A shipped agent inside the analytics platform artist teams already use — changes how release and campaign research gets done.

picks.excerpt: Hotone's Pulze Jr. is a 20W battery-powered stereo mini amp with 52 amp models and AI-powered preset generation built in. It's a small but telling sign that generative tone-design is migrating from plugins into cheap physical hardware.
picks.rationale: Generative tone design lands in cheap physical hardware — a concrete product, not a concept, and the only gear pick in the set.
